description: Look up a US property by address. Returns the normalized address, coordinates, and whether Street View covers it. May save a temporary property reference; repeated lookups may create new records. Use it before prepare_design_review for a preview-only flow, or before design_yard when generation is intended. The satellite image and outline are shown in the owner-bound property review before a design is made: design_yard's first result shows it in the chat (in the Yarda card where the chat app displays it), so do not tell the user Yarda will first send them a link. If `precise` is false, ask the user to confirm the house or give a more exact address (cul-de-sacs often geocode to the wrong house).

address.description: Full US street address with city and state

name: find_property

property_ref.description: Opaque locator for this exact lookup (C3): pass it back to design_yard so the review prepares against the same property. A locator, never a credential; it expires.

title: Find Property
